d:
A playful melody, a charming on-screen pair, and two legendary voices make “Nahin Nahin Abhi Nahin” an unforgettable Bollywood favourite! From the 1972 film Jawani Diwani, this popular romantic duet features Randhir Kapoor and Jaya Bhaduri, with the evergreen voices of Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle bringing its flirtatious charm to life.
Nahin Nahin Abhi Nahin | Jawani Diwani 1972 | Randhir Kapoor, Jaya Bhaduri | Kishore-Asha Love Duets
Song: Nahin Nahin Abhi Nahin Abhi Karo Intezar
Movie: Jawani Diwani (1972)
Star Cast: Randhir Kapoor, Jaya Bhaduri
Singers: Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle
